categories.main_business_segments: Ever Ohms Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of chip resistors, including thick film resistors, thin film resistors, and metal plate resistors. The company focuses on high-power, automotive-grade, high-voltage, and precision resistors, serving various applications such as 5G, AI, automotive electronics, industrial automation, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs thick film, thin film, and metal plate resistor manufacturing technologies. Thick film resistors use screen printing and firing processes with silver, palladium, and ruthenium materials. Thin film resistors utilize sputtering and laser trimming for high precision and miniaturization. Metal plate resistors are made from alloy substrates with stamping and trimming processes, offering ultra-low resistance and high power capabilities. The company continuously develops new materials, designs, and processes to enhance product performance, including high power, anti-sulfur, and surge-resistant features.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include EMS/OEM/ODM manufacturers and brand companies in sectors such as power supplies, networking/communication equipment, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, industrial control, and smart home appliances. The company serves global markets with a focus on China and other international regions, targeting high-growth areas like electric vehicles, AI-related industries, 5G communications, and industrial automation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan and China, with manufacturing facilities in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, and Shenzhen, China. Sales are predominantly export-oriented, with approximately 74% of revenue from China and other overseas markets. The company also maintains a sales office in New Taipei City, Taiwan, and plans to expand its overseas production bases to support global customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ever Ohms operates in the midstream segment of the passive electronic components supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of chip resistors. It procures raw materials such as substrates, pastes, and packaging materials from upstream suppliers and sells finished resistor products to downstream customers including electronic device manufacturers and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D to develop high-precision, low TCR, high-voltage, and high-power resistors tailored for AI, automotive, 5G, and industrial automation applications. It invests in product miniaturization, enhanced reliability, and new materials to meet evolving market demands. Strategic initiatives include expanding product lines, improving production automation and quality, integrating resources across Taiwan and China, and pursuing ESG and sustainability goals such as carbon neutrality and green manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chip resistor products across thick film, thin film, and metal plate categories. The company sells to EMS/OEM/ODM manufacturers and brand customers, with pricing based on product specifications and volume. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue; income is product sales-driven.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major global competitors include Japanese firms Murata, TDK, Taiyo Yuden, ROHM, Panasonic, KOA, and Kyocera; American companies Kemet and Vishay; Korean SEMCO; Taiwanese firms Yageo, KEMET, Walsin, and others; and Chinese companies Fenghua and Sanhuan. Ever Ohms is positioned as a specialized manufacturer with capabilities in thick film, thin film, and metal plate resistors, focusing on niche and high-value markets such as automotive and industrial electronics to differentiate from larger competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported net revenue of approximately NT$1.27 billion, a 34.5% increase from the previous year, with a net profit of NT$56.8 million reversing prior losses. Total assets were about NT$2.14 billion with shareholders' equity of NT$1.46 billion. The company has shown a positive growth trajectory with improved profitability, increased production utilization, and expanding market share, supported by ongoing capital investments and R&D spending around 2.4% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ever Ohms emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio covering thick film, thin film, and metal plate resistors, enabling tailored solutions for diverse customer needs. The company highlights high precision, high power, anti-sulfur, surge resistance, and automotive-grade certifications (AEC-Q200) as key differentiators. Its integration of advanced manufacturing technologies and close collaboration with customers for customized solutions enhances product reliability and performance, supporting applications in cutting-edge fields like AI, 5G, and electric vehicles.
